cpu.validation: Linux x86_64 and Windows x64 CPU passes are recorded in the execution matrix (docs/EXECUTION_MATRIX.md); other listed platforms need their own acceptance

cu126.validation: Upstream wheel and architecture matrix checked; which cards ran is recorded per slot in the execution matrix (docs/EXECUTION_MATRIX.md); acceptance is per model, card and driver

cu128.validation: Upstream wheel and Blackwell matrix checked; Blackwell (RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5070) and Turing (RTX 2070 Max-Q) passes on Windows x64 are recorded in the execution matrix (docs/EXECUTION_MATRIX.md); the bound covers all of 12.x because sm_120 binaries run on sm_121 (CUDA binary compatibility within a major version), with no 12.1 card run recorded; acceptance is per model, card and driver

cu130.validation: Candidate: linux-aarch64 (SBSA) cu130 wheels for torch 2.10.0 and torchvision 0.25.0 for cp311-cp313 are listed on the index (the first cu130 torchvision with aarch64 wheels); the wheel's architecture list is not verified here and doctor records it as cuda_architectures; Jetson Orin (8.7) stays on the vendor build; no hardware run recorded

rocm64.validation: Candidate for ROCm 6.4 supported GPUs and distributions; native acceptance pending

xpu.validation: Windows x86_64 source execution recorded on Intel Arc B580 and Arc 130V with torch 2.8.0+xpu (E-099, E-101); Linux candidate, native acceptance pending; not Intel NPU

mps.validation: Bounded native MPS passes for MiniLM and SmolLM2 chat on an Apple M4 Max (E-031, E-038; HW-13); not Apple Neural Engine; other models need their own acceptance

onnx-cpu.validation: Prepared-graph CPU execution validated on Linux x86_64 and native Windows ARM64 (MiniLM/digit graphs); other listed platforms await native qualification

qnn.validation: Native Windows ARM64 QNN HTP trained-classifier execution validated; compatible Snapdragon driver and model preparation required

coreml.validation: Candidate: Core ML provider; CPU use inside Core ML is permitted by Apple and is not ANE-only proof

openvino-cpu.validation: CPU Linux x86_64 runtime validated; Intel GPU/NPU targets await native qualification

openvino-gpu.validation: Trained-model native Windows execution validated on Intel Iris Xe, Arc B580/A770 and integrated Intel GPUs; compatible system drivers remain required

openvino-npu.validation: Native Intel AI Boost NPU trained-model execution validated; driver and prepared-graph compatibility still required

genai-cpu.validation: OpenVINO graph check; LLM model qualification is separate

onnx-intel-mac.validation: Recorded from source on an Intel MacBook Pro with onnxruntime 1.23.2 (E-094, E-098): prepared ONNX embeddings, VAD and tensor graphs; macOS 13+ x86_64 wheels for Python 3.11–3.13; sherpa, tesseract and GGUF rows are separate installs; no PyTorch modality stack on this platform; target-native package open (HW-15)

genai-gpu.validation: Candidate: OpenVINO GenAI prepared LLM adapter; requires Intel GPU drivers and native model qualification

genai-npu.validation: Candidate: OpenVINO GenAI prepared LLM adapter; requires Intel NPU drivers and native model qualification

engine.validation: Core engine import only; install a native runtime separately and qualify the actual model/device

dml.validation: Native trained-model DirectML execution validated on AMD Radeon 840M/Raphael, Intel Iris Xe and NVIDIA RTX 3500 Ada; model operators, memory and drivers still limit support

dml-arm64.validation: Native Windows ARM64 Adreno trained-classifier execution validated via the wheel DirectML provider; no system Windows App SDK install was required by that path
